questions.question:
Simplify the following expression.

4 - 3 of (1(1)/(2) + (1)/(3) div (1)/(2) of 4-(1)/(4))

While listing N consecutive even numbers for determining their average, the last number, by mistake, got replaced by the next odd number and thereby the average turned out to be more than the desired value by 0.0125. What is the value of N?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The next odd number after any even number L is L + 1.

Total Increase in Sum = (L + 1) − L = 1.

Increase in Average = (Total Increase in Sum) ÷ (Number of Terms N).

0.0125 = 1 ÷ N

N = 1 ÷ 0.0125 = 80.

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of consecutive even numbers = N

Error: Last even number replaced by next odd number

Increase in average = 0.0125

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e60de71f8d76c81c51127486d8316eaf7d0f398414175c6dfe74df0cbb3a51f6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the N consecutive even numbers be E₁, E₂, ..., EN.

⇒ Let their original sum be S.

⇒ Original Average = S ÷ N.

⇒ The last number EN is replaced by (EN + 1).

⇒ New Sum = S − EN + (EN + 1) = S + 1.

⇒ New Average = (S + 1) ÷ N = (S ÷ N) + (1 ÷ N).

⇒ Change in average = (New Average) − (Original Average) = 1 ÷ N.

⇒ Given that this change is 0.0125.

⇒ 1 ÷ N = 0.0125

⇒ N = 1 ÷ 0.0125

⇒ N = 10000 ÷ 125 = 80.

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effect of Observation Change on Average

If a single observation in a set of N terms is increased by 'k', the new average increases by exactly k ÷ N compared to the old average.

Consecutive Even Numbers

Consecutive even numbers form an Arithmetic Progression (AP) with a common difference of 2. The average of any N consecutive numbers in an AP is (First term + Last term) ÷ 2.

Decimal to Fraction Conversion

Shortcut for N: Since 0.125 = 1/8, then 0.0125 = 1/80. Therefore, 1 ÷ N = 1 ÷ 80 implies N = 80.</p

questions.question: The mean of a set of 120 observations is 80. 10 is subtracted from each observation and each of the corresponding result is divided by 7. What is the mean of the new set?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mean of 120 set is 80

**Concept used:**

Mean = Sum of observation/No. of observation

**Calculation:**

Total of 120 observation = 120 × 80

⇒ 9600

After decreasing new total = 9600 - 10 × 120

⇒ 8400

Now,

After dividing each term by 7 new total = 8400/7 = 1200

Now,

New mean = 1200/120

⇒ 10

**∴ The mean of the new set is 10**

questions.question: A man had to travel 49 km, which he divided into six stretches which were exact multiples of either 4 km or 5 km. The first four stretches were 4 km, 5 km, 8 km and 10 km. Multiples of 4 km and 5 km were travelled at the rates of 40 and 60 km/h, respectively, and between two consecutive stretches, he rested for six minutes. What was his average speed (in km/h) for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 49 km

Speed for the distances of multiple of 4 = 40 km/h

Speed for the distances of multiple of 5 = 60 km/h

**Concept used:**

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

**Calculation:**

Remaining distance = 49 - (4 + 5 + 8 + 10)

⇒ 22 km

Only 12 km and 10 km is possible according to the question,

Total time taken to complete the journey = (4/40 + 5/60 + 8/40 + 10/60 + 12/40 + 10/60)h + 6 × 5 m [Total 5 times halt of 6 minutes each]

⇒ (1/10 + 1/12 + 1/5 + 1/6 + 3/10 + 1/6)h + 30 m

⇒ (6 + 5 + 12 + 10 + 18 + 10)/60 + 1/2

⇒ 61/60 + 1/2

⇒ 91/60 hours

Average speed = 49 × 60/91

⇒ 420/13

⇒ 32(4)/({13)}

**∴ His average speed (in km/h) for the whole journey was 32(4)/({13)}**

questions.question: Which number lying between 800 and 900 is such that when it is divided by either of 34 and 51, the remainder left is 19?

questions.question: A retailer purchased 50 kg of a vegetable from a wholesale market. He sold half of it at a profit of Rs. 450, and the rest at a loss of Rs. 275. What was the difference (in Rs.) between the two selling prices per kg of the vegetable?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A retailer purchased 50 kg of a vegetable from a wholesale market.

He sold half of it at a profit of Rs. 450, and the rest at a loss of Rs. 275

**Concept used:**

SP = CP + Profit

SP = CP - Loss

**Calculation:**

Let CP of 1 kg vegetable be Rs. x

Total CP = 50x

Now,

SP of 1st half = 25x + 450

SP of 2nd half = 25x - 275

Diiference in SP = (25x + 450)/25 - (25x - 275)/25

⇒ (25x + 450 - 25x + 275)/25

⇒ 725/25

⇒ 29

**∴ The difference (in Rs.) between the two selling prices per kg of the vegetable is 29**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Taking profit as positive sign and loss as negative sign. 

The difference in the selling price of 25 kg vegetable = +450 - (-275) = 725

The difference in per kg selling price = 725/25 = 29

∴ The required difference in per kg selling price is Rs. 29.

questions.question: A man takes a loan of Rs. 6,000 from his friend on 1st January 2019 with the condition that he will repay with accrued simple interest at the rate 6.25% per annum, as and when the interest touches Rs. 75. On which date does the loan period expire?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 6000

Rate of interest = 6.25% Per annum

Asked interest = Rs. 75

**Concept used:**

S.I = PTR/100

**Calculation:**

Rate of interest for 1 month = 6.25/12%

So, monthly interest = 6000 × 6.25/1200

⇒ Rs. 31.25

So, to touch Rs. 75 it will take = 75/31.25 = 2.4 months or 72 days

So, at 73rd day it will touch Rs. 75

So, 30 days in January + 28 days in February + 15 days in March = 73 days

**∴ On 15th March 2019 the loan period got expired.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper sells an article at 14% discount on its marked price and still gains 20%. If the cost price of the article is Rs. 184.90, then what is its marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount % = 14

Profit % = 20%

CP = Rs. 184.9

**Concept used:**

SP = MP - MP × Discount%

SP = CP + Profit

**Calculation:**

SP = 184.9 × 120/100

Now,

SP = MP × 43/50

Let MP be Rs. x

So,

184.9 × 6/5 = 43x/50

⇒ x = 184.9 × 60/43

⇒ x = 258

So, MP = Rs. 258

**∴ Marked price is Rs. 258**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 16,000 invested, amounts to Rs. 21,160 in two years. What is the rate per cent per annum in C.I ?
questions.solution:

Time = 2 year

**Formula used:**

A = P (1 + R/100)T

Where, A = Amount, P = Principal, T = Time, and R = rate of interest

**Calculation:**

T = 2 years

According to the question,

21160 = 16000(1 + R/100)²

⇒ 21160/16000 = (1 + R/100)2

⇒ 46/40 = (1 + R/100)

⇒ 23/20 = (1 + R/100) 

⇒ 2300 = 2000 + 20R

⇒ R = 300/20

⇒ R = 15

questions.question: The lengths of one side and a diagonal of a rectangle are 63 cm and 65 cm, respectively. What is the perimeter (in cm) of a square whose area is one-seventh of that of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Pythagorean triplet (16, 63, 65), the width of the rectangle is 16 cm.

Area of the square = (Area of rectangle) ÷ 7 = (63 × 16) ÷ 7

Area of the square = 9 × 16 = 144 cm².

Side of the square = √144 = 12 cm.

Perimeter of the square = 4 × 12 = 48 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of one side of the rectangle (l) = 63 cm

Length of the diagonal (d) = 65 cm

**Formula Used:**

Pythagoras theorem: d² = l² + w²

Area of rectangle = l × w

Area of square = a²

Perimeter of square = 4 × a

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34aa3b9d3a8e03d6254dbc530e625348d0a963cf8c6a1d225b18f5f80da4a980.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ w = √(65² − 63²)

⇒ w = √[(65 − 63) × (65 + 63)]

⇒ w = √(2 × 128) = √256 = 16 cm

⇒ Area of the rectangle = 63 × 16 = 1008 cm²

⇒ Area of the square = 1008 ÷ 7 = 144 cm²

⇒ Side of the square (a) = √144 = 12 cm

⇒ Perimeter of the square = 4 × 12 = 48 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagoras Theorem & Triplets

In any right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides (a² + b² = c²). Common triplets like (16, 63, 65) or (5, 12, 13) frequently appear in exams and greatly save computation time if memorised.

Rectangle Properties

A rectangle has opposite sides equal and parallel. The area is Length × Width. The perimeter is 2 × (Length + Width). The length of the diagonal is √(Length² + Width²).

Square Properties

A square is a special rectangle with all four sides equal. The area is Side². The perimeter is 4 × Side. The length of its diagonal is Side × √2.

questions.question: Three jugs of equal capacity are filled with mixtures of milk and water in the proportions 3 ∶ 1, 7 ∶ 1 and 11 ∶ 5. The three jugs are emptied into a single container. What will be the ratio of water to milk in the said container?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Three jugs of equal capacity are filled with mixtures of milk and water in the proportions 3 ∶ 1, 7 ∶ 1 and 11 ∶ 5

**Calculation:**

Quantity of milk in the final mixture = 3/4 + 7/8 + 11/16 = (12 + 14 + 11)/16 = 37/16 

Quantity of water in the final mixture = 1/4 + 1/8 + 5/16 = (4 + 2 + 5)/16 = 11/16

Ratio of water and milk in the final mixture = 11 : 37

**∴ The ratio of water to milk in the said container is 11 : 37**

Total work = LCM of the time taken by each person

So, total in 10 days

Y can do one-third of the work in 10 days

So, total in 30 days

LCM of 10 and 30 is 30 i.e total work

Efficiency of X and Y = 30/10, 30/30

questions.question: The total surface area of a solid right circular cone is equal to that of a sphere of the same radius. The height of the cone is how many times the diameter of the sphere?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total surface area of a solid right circular cone is equal to that of a sphere of the same radius.

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of a right circular cone = π(r + l)r

Total surface area of a sphere = 4πr²

Slant height(l) = Radius² + Height²

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

π(r + l)r = 4πr2

⇒ (r + l) = 4r

⇒ l = 3r

l² = H² + r²

⇒ 9r² = H2 + r2

⇒ 8r2 = H2

⇒ H = 2√2r

Now,

Diameter = 2r

So, Height is 2√2r/2r = √2 times

**∴ Required answer is √2**

questions.question: The average of a number and its reciprocal is 1. What is the average of its square, cube and fourth power?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of a number and its reciprocal is 1

**Concept used:**

If x + 1/x = 2

Then, x = 1

**Calculation:**

Let the number be x

So, its reciprocal = 1/x

Average = 1

So, total = 1 × 2 = 2

So, x + 1/x = 2

So, x = 1

Now we know any power of 1 is always 1

So, average = (1 + 1 + 1)/3 = 1

**∴ Average is 1**
